description.en: The lodge's outdoor training grounds. The mountain pass stays closed until graduation.
description.zh-CN: 山舍的户外训练场。出师之后才能从山道下山。

description.en: Your tutor. More lessons await after graduation.
description.zh-CN: 你的导师。出师后还有后续教学。

description.en: One day: Strength +1, Vitality +1, Iron Seal Strike +1 rank, up to its current cap.
description.zh-CN: 一天：力量+1、体质+1，铁印重击提升一级，受当前上限限制。

description.en: One day: Strength +1, Vitality +1, Force Hammer +1 rank, up to its current cap.
description.zh-CN: 一天：力量+1、体质+1，力场巨锤提升一级，受当前上限限制。

description.en: One day: Agility +2, Arcane Rain +1 rank, up to its current cap.
description.zh-CN: 一天：敏捷+2，奥术骤雨提升一级，受当前上限限制。

description.en: Outdoor training; the way out opens after graduation.
description.zh-CN: 户外训练；出师后可从这里下山。

description.en: Spend one day improving your focus.
One day: Vitality +1, maximum Health +15 and Energy +15.
description.zh-CN: 一天：体质+1，生命上限与能量上限各+15。

description.en: A side trail with further challenges.
Return to the indoor practice rooms.
Complete your initial training before leaving.
description.zh-CN: 完成初步训练后才能下山。

text.en: Another day. The snow has made no progress on shoveling itself.
text.zh-CN: 新的一天。雪依然没有学会自己走开。

text.en: Not yet. Finish the lodge's training first; then the mountain pass opens.
text.zh-CN: 还不能走。先完成山舍训练，山道才会开放。

text.en: One more lap through the snow. My footprints are getting very good at this.
text.zh-CN: 又在雪里跑了一圈。我的脚印快比我练得好了。

text.en: Iron Seal Strike. The practice post has declined to offer feedback.
text.zh-CN: 铁印重击。木桩表示不想发表评论。

text.en: Force Hammer! A useful spell, provided I point it away from the roof.
text.zh-CN: 力场巨锤！这法术不错，记得别对着屋顶。

text.en: Arcane Rain. Finally, weather I can take credit for.
text.zh-CN: 奥术骤雨。总算有一种天气，是我说了算。

text.en: A quiet day of meditation. Even the kettle knows better than to interrupt.
text.zh-CN: 静心冥想了一天。连水壶都懂得别打扰。

text.en: A visiting challenger is here. Show them what you've learned. The floor is already insured.
text.zh-CN: 来了一位挑战者。让他看看你学到了什么，地板的损失我来承担。

text.en: And if my demonstration involves falling over?
text.zh-CN: 要是我展示的是如何摔倒呢？

text.en: Then we practice again. Take these remedies first.
text.zh-CN: 那就再练。先拿上这些药。

text.en: A friendly bout, then. I'd bow, but my shoulders are full of snow.
text.zh-CN: 友好切磋一场吧。我想鞠躬，可肩上还堆着雪。

text.en: You're up. Try to leave the visitor in one piece.
text.zh-CN: 你上吧，记得给客人留个完整的身子。

text.en: I'll aim for a warm welcome.
text.zh-CN: 争取让他感受到热烈欢迎。

text.en: Well fought. I should have warmed up before coming up the mountain.
text.zh-CN: 打得好。上山前真该先热热身。

text.en: You've earned this Flamehand Strike guide. Keep the flames away from the curtains.
text.zh-CN: 这本焰掌教材是你应得的，别烧着窗帘。

text.en: A reward with a fire warning. My favorite kind.
text.zh-CN: 附带防火提醒的奖励，正合我意。

text.en: A lost bout, not a lost education. Recover, then return to training. Graduation doesn't require winning this match.
text.zh-CN: 输了一场，不等于白学。恢复一下再练；这场输赢不决定能否出师。

text.en: Your first training is complete. The mountain pass is open to you.
text.zh-CN: 初步训练完成了。你可以下山了。

text.en: And the lodge's greatest mastery?
text.zh-CN: 那山舍最厉害的专精呢？

text.en: Earn it on your travels. I'm sending the Hatter with you; someone should keep track of teatime.
text.zh-CN: 还要靠旅途上的历练。我让疯帽匠跟你同行，总得有人记得喝茶。

text.en: Ready! I've packed the cups. You can carry the sensible decisions.
text.zh-CN: 准备好了！茶杯归我带，明智决定归你带。

text.en: That's a worrying division of labor.
text.zh-CN: 这分工听起来有点不妙。

text.en: Look after each other. The pass is beyond the snowy training grounds.
text.zh-CN: 互相照应。下山的出口在雪地训练场那边。

text.en: Back already? Good. The kettle has been asking after you.
text.zh-CN: 这么快回来了？正好，水壶刚还问起你呢。

出师大轮寺。.en: Graduated from Grail Lodge. The Mad Hatter joined the party.
出师大轮寺。.zh-CN: 圣杯山舍出师，疯帽匠加入队伍。

academies.graduationStory: 门派大轮寺_大轮寺出师

intro.en: A guided training route for gauntlets and spells. Each practice spends a day; the mountain pass opens after graduation. The Mad Hatter joins then, not on arrival.
intro.zh-CN: 有完整指引的拳套与法术训练路线。每次练习花费一天，出师后才能下山，疯帽匠也在那时加入。

trainingDetail.en: Pick a training activity below. Each practice advances one day and grants the listed growth. Graduation triggers after more than 60 adventure days, during training; opening menus does not advance time. You stay affiliated after leaving.
trainingDetail.zh-CN: 选择下方训练。每次花费一天，获得列出的成长。冒险总天数超过60天后，在训练中触发出师；打开菜单不会推进时间。下山后仍保留组织身份。

graduateDetail.en: The Mad Hatter joined through graduation. Check his gear and mastery in Adventurer. Go through the Snowfields, then Leave the Mountain. This is graduation, not quitting the lodge. Save before exploring.
graduateDetail.zh-CN: 疯帽匠已通过出师剧情加入。在人物页为他检查装备和专精。前往雪地，再选下山；出师并不取消组织身份，探索前记得保存。
